source.name: SportsPro: South Africa Rugby upgrades FNB to Springboks front-of-shirt sponsor
source.quote: FNB logo will feature on the front of all matchday jerseys, including men’s and women’s Springboks
source.note: FNB confirmed as principal partner of all SA Rugby national teams on 26-27 March 2025, replacing MTN; the same article says the FNB logo would first appear on the front of the Springbok Test jersey against Italy in Pretoria on 5 July 2025. Exact contract length not stated, so 'to' is null.
